numerical_policy.unresolved_noise_upper_bound: conservative total input-equivalent noise; not an intrinsic residual
numerical_policy.truth: Numerical representation policy is separate from declared physical uncertainty; no physical tolerance or L3 acceptance is granted.

applicability: Supplied sinusoidal acoustic/electrical calibration reference, separated deployment gain, uncorrelated same-band RMS noise sources and electrical peak headroom
assumptions: common integration bandwidth and weighting for every noise source
independent noise sources, no correlated cancellation
sinusoidal calibrator, output RMS below ADC clipping
relative bounds are conservative intervals, not statistical confidence
excluded: capsule acoustic overload from small-signal gain
combined signal/noise peak immunity without a noise crest-factor bound
